description:
We are looking for a System Administration professional highly skilled in GO for our Infrastructure Tools & Automation Team.  You will play a crucial role in the engineering and development of AT&T's next generation Linux automation tool.  You will work closely with other system automation engineers to implement critical design elements and infrastructure stakeholders to understand business-critical applications and data infrastructure. 
 
 What You’ll Do 
 We are looking for a System Administration professional highly skilled in GO for our Infrastructure Tools & Automation Team.  You will play a crucial role in the engineering and development of AT&T's next generation Linux automation tool.  You will work closely with other system automation engineers to implement critical design elements and infrastructure stakeholders to understand business-critical applications and data infrastructure. 
 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools using GO 

 Manage lifecycle activities for Linux, UNIX, and Windows Server systems and applications, including inventory, patching, and decommissioning.

 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support infrastructure for business-critical applications and databases.

 Ensure system reliability, performance, and security through proactive monitoring and automation.

 Support compliance, documentation, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.

 Cover working hours: 9 am – 5 pm, with occasional flexibility as per business need.

 
 What You’ll Need 
 3+ years experience in automation and scripting using GO 

 Hands-on experience in application / system lifecycle management, patching, automation, merging etc.

 Experience supporting enterprise environments.

 Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with attention to detail and system reliability.

 
 What You’ll Bring 
 Strategic mindset and proactive approach to problem-solving and process improvement.

 Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and business teams.

 Passion for system reliability, automation, and delivering high-impact solutions.

 
 This position is hybrid, and you may be expected to go into Bratislava office 3 days a week.
 Our GO Developer earns between 3,100 - 4,700 EUR gross / month. Not to mention all the other amazing rewards that working at AT&T offers. Individual starting salary within this range may depend on experience, expertise, and education/training.  
 
 Joining our team comes with amazing perks and benefits:
 Annual Bonus & Annual Salary Increase

 Meal Allowance (€4 / workday)

 Cafeteria Benefits

 Multisport card

 MetLife Insurance

 Pension Contribution 

 Special Occasions Contribution: €500 for events like marriage, childbirth, or retirement.

 Annual Medical Plan: ProCare polyclinic

 Service Anniversary Program

 Family-friendly benefits

 Volunteering day

 Income Loss Compensation

 Recreation Contribution: 55% of up to €500 spent, after 2 years of service.

 Employee Assistance Program (free psychological, legal and financial counseling)

 International Employee Referral Program

 Various discounts

 
 Apply today!










Our Sr Specialist Systems Administration jobs earn between €39,400.00 - €59,200.00 Annual. Not to mention all the other amazing rewards that working at AT&T offers. Individual starting salary within this range may depend on geography, experience, expertise, and education/training.
